lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial region, forming distinct horizontal and vertical axes across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular blobs, defining a lattice-like structure of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of small, yellow-and-black striped commensal fish (likely pilot fish) are visible near the snout and anterior ventral region.
